[Code on GitHub](https://github.com/Hendesson/-Banco-de-Queimadas---Parque-Distrital-Boca-da-Mata){.btn .btn-primary}

A web system for **mapping and monitoring fires** in Boca da Mata District Park, in Brazil's Federal District. Users can record fire occurrences **with their geographic location**, together with photos, coordinates and the size of the affected area.
